description: Figure 9 is a box plot that illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations by tag on the probing accuracy of different models. The x-axis represents different tags such as case, gender, tag, number, and tense. The y-axis measures the effect, which is the percentage reduction in probing accuracy due to context masking perturbations. The box plot shows the distribution of the effect for each tag, with error bars indicating the standard deviation. The models compared are mBERT-L, XLM-L, mBERT-R, XLM-R, mBERT-B, and XLM-B. The effect is generally small, with some tags showing a more significant reduction in accuracy.
